content: आवृत्तिः {%f.%} .²1 Turning towards; return, coming back; तपोवनावृत्तिपथम् <ls>R. 2. 18</ls>; यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः <ls>Bg. 8. 23</ls>. .²2 Reversion, retreat, flight. .²3 Revolving, whirling, going round; रटति कृतावृत्तिखट्वाङ्घण्टा <ls>Māl. 5. 4</ls>. .²4 Recurrence to the same point or place (of the sun); उदगावृत्तिपथेन नारदः <ls>R. 8. 33</ls>. .²5 Repetition of birth and death, wordly existence; अनावृत्तिभयम् <ls>Ku. 6. 77</ls>. .²6 Repetition in general, an edition (modern use); सप्तमीयमङ्कनावृत्तिः seventh edition. .²7 Repeated reading, study; आवृत्तिः सर्वशास्त्राणां बोधादपि गरीयसि <ls>Udb.</ls> <ab>cf.</ab> also तस्मादावृत्तिः स्तरणमन्त्रस्य . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 12. 1. 42</ls>. .²8 Use, employment, application. .²9 Turn of a way, course or direction. .²10 Occurrence.
